newsitem.title: USA: First Chicago in cash management pacts.
newsitem.headline: First Chicago in cash management pacts.

text.p: First Chicago NBD Corp said on Monday that it has entered agreements with Standard Chartered Bank, a unit of Standard Chartered Plc, and Bank of Nova Scotia to provide cash management services.
Under the agreements, First Chicago's large corporate customers will receive services through both banks in certain locations. In return, Standard Chartered will receive fees for the services.
Bank of Nova Scotia customers will receive similar services through First Chicago. Both Bank of Nova Scotia and First Chicago will receive fees from those services.
First Chicago also said it is evaluating similar opportunities in other markets.
